prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: rear-end collision. Injury: neck and back strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1210; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], regarding the rear-end collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. The facts of this incident are straightforward. Your insured's vehicle struck the rear of our client's vehicle while our client was stopped in traffic. The police report documents the impact and assigns responsibility to your insured for failing to stop in time.

As a direct result of the collision, our client sustained neck and back strain. Following the accident, our client sought prompt medical evaluation and has been undergoing ongoing treatment, including physical therapy and prescribed medication. Our client continues to experience pain, stiffness, and limited mobility, which have interfered with daily activities and work responsibilities.

Under the applicable standard of care and the principles of comparative negligence in this jurisdiction, your insured is liable for the damages caused by this collision. These damages include past and future medical expenses, lost wages, and pain and suffering.

We therefore demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve this claim in full. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file a civil complaint without further notice.
